Optronic — Website Hero

Cover pending — /public/work/[slug]/

Project context

Optronic is an industrial optics manufacturer offering precision measurement products across European markets. Their existing site had grown organically — inconsistent content, difficult product discovery, no coherent multilingual structure.

The project was a ground-up redesign and rebuild — not a reskin, but a structural rethink of how the company presents products, communicates technical specifications, and supports customers finding the right product.

The challenge

Structural,
not cosmetic.

  • /01A coherent EN/DE multilingual architecture with consistent navigation and SEO structure
  • /029 product categories needing dedicated pages with appropriate technical depth
  • /03Hosted manuals and firmware previously scattered across third-party links
  • /04A scalable content model the client team could maintain without a developer
  • /05A live preview workflow allowing real-time review and annotation rather than static PDFs

IA & UX decisions

Four calls
that shaped
the site.

  • /01

    Multilingual-first navigation

    Designed from scratch with EN/DE parity as a constraint — consistent URL patterns, per-language meta, and a language toggle that does not disrupt the user's product context.

  • /02

    Product discovery, not just listing

    IA structured for both users who know the product they want and users finding the right product by application — measurement type, precision range, or use case.

  • /03

    Hosted downloads as a first-class feature

    Manuals and firmware brought into the product page structure directly — findable in context, versioned, consistently formatted.

  • /04

    SEO-friendly content structure

    Each product page designed with proper heading hierarchy and structured metadata — supporting product-specific search intent, not generic brand SEO.

Outcome

Shipped.
Maintained.

Live with full multilingual structure, all 9 product pages, download hosting, and a component architecture the client team can maintain without developer involvement.

  • Shipped to production with full EN/DE structure and all 9 product pages

  • Content-managed structure — routine updates without developer involvement

  • Live preview + annotation workflow reduced design-to-sign-off round-trip time

  • Component architecture built around maintainability, not bespoke layouts
